enforcement_note: No hook can read a plan and decide whether its problem statement is separable from its solution. The real mechanism is the agent working the questions at Phase 1 and the user reading the answers before approving the plan.
condition: Any plan that changes shared state, published artifacts, or production behaviour.
rule: Ask what this plan costs if it is wrong, and whether it can be taken back, as questions.
ai_action: Work through the checklist against the plan, before the work begins. Report the answers, including the ones that pass. Where the plan simply does not address an item, say so -- an absent answer is the finding, not a reason to skip the item.

checklist.question: Is the rollback path stated, and has it been performed rather than assumed?
checklist.remediation_hint: Write the rollback command and run it once against a scratch copy.
checklist.group_condition: When the change touches shared or persistent state

checklist.question: What is the blast radius if this is wrong -- who or what is affected beyond the change itself?
checklist.remediation_hint: List the downstream consumers; if the list is unknown, that is the finding.
checklist.group_condition: When the change touches shared or persistent state

checklist.question: Can this be delivered as a smaller reversible increment first?
checklist.remediation_hint: Split off the increment that can be shipped and undone independently.
checklist.group_condition: When the change touches shared or persistent state

checklist.question: Does the plan touch anything irreversible -- published history, the ledger, credentials?
checklist.remediation_hint: Stop and check it against the Tier-0 prohibitions before planning further.

checklist.question: If this plan is abandoned halfway, is the system left in a working state?
checklist.remediation_hint: Reorder the steps so each one lands complete.

checklist.question: Has 'what can go wrong' been asked explicitly, not only 'what are we building'?
checklist.remediation_hint: Spend one pass listing failure modes before listing steps.
checklist.group_condition: When the change is exposed to untrusted input or external systems

checklist.question: Are the risks that were identified and knowingly accepted written down, not just the mitigated ones?
checklist.remediation_hint: Record the accepted risk and who accepted it.
checklist.group_condition: When the change is exposed to untrusted input or external systems

anti_pattern: Do not convert these questions into prescriptions, and do not answer them from the plan's own summary. A plan review reads the plan looking for what is absent; a summary is written by the same author and repeats what is present.

provenance.source: agent-generated; every item cites a source resolved on 2026-08-05
provenance.basis: Plan-review gap: .ai/05-domains/ reviews code that already exists, so a plan was reviewed by nothing. Items phrased as review questions per the checklist-not-prescription rule.

note: Reversibility is decided at planning time; after the change it is a fact, not a choice.
